description.value: Pappa Leo's is a locally owned and operated pizza chain founded in 2003 by two brothers in Pitt Meadows, now grown to seven lower mainland locations. The Coquitlam Schoolhouse Street outlet is one of those independently managed franchises, known for scratch-made dough prepared daily and award-winning recipes. Cyclists can order pizza for pickup or delivery, with contactless payment and an environmentally focused packaging policy.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM phone number 604-553-4933 matches the Coquitlam Schoolhouse St location listed on the website (#2-228 Schoolhouse Street, Coquitlam, BC V3K 6V7), and OSM addr:unit '2' corroborates unit #2 in that address. The website confirms an active pizza takeout/delivery chain with seven lower mainland locations. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; gluten-free crust is explicitly offered on the locations page.
